name: BURKE, the Hon. Anthony (Tony) Stephen

headline.note: The pre-parliament record includes two overlapping retail jobs and a company directorship, but no source establishes substantive full-time hours or exact work dates. Political staff, nonprofit advocacy, union work and elected office are excluded categories. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Parliament biography identifies the employer and 1982–1987 years, refining the frozen biography's combined 1982–1991 sales/shop-assistant entry. Burke was aged about 12 at commencement; hours, pay, school-term pattern and exact dates are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private-sector work is identified, but neither substantive full-time status nor countable day/month boundaries are proven.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Parliament biography identifies Grace Bros Roselands and 1985–1991, overlapping newsagency work through 1987 and university study. Hours, leave and exact dates are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private-sector work is identified, but full-time status is not established and overlapping intervals cannot be summed.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies establish the qualification and the NSW Parliament biography gives 1992 completion. Enrolment date and study load are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Parliament biography records lobbyist/director service in 1995–1997; a contemporaneous parliamentary record identifies Burke as the group's coordinator. Legal entity, pay, hours, exact dates and overlap with Aticus are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Advocacy/nonprofit work is excluded under the codebook; no private-enterprise classification is inferred from the title 'director'.

career_spells.employer: Aticus Pty Ltd (also reported as Atticus Pty Ltd)
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies supply the role and years, while secondary reporting describes a business providing advocacy and communication training. Sources vary between Aticus and Atticus. Directorship alone does not establish employee status, substantive hours or remuneration; exact dates and overlap with advocacy work remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: A private company is identified, but directorship does not prove full-time employment, so no headline duration is calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Parliament biography records this 1997 role. Exact dates, pay, hours and overlap with Aticus, Euthanasia No! and the SDA transition are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Association/campaign work is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Shop, Distributive and Allied Employees' Association
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies agree on employer, role and year endpoints. Exact appointment and cessation dates, hours, leave and the 1997 overlap with other roles are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Union employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biographies provide exact service dates. Committee and officeholder duties are nested within this elected service. Any campaign period or other work between resignation and federal election is unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member for Watson; ministerial and shadow roles nested within service
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current official biographies establish continuous House service from 9 October 2004. Ministerial and shadow appointments do not create additional employment spells for headline counting.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

open_questions: What were the exact dates, pay, weekly hours, leave and school/study overlap for the Beverly Hills Newsagency and Grace Bros jobs?
What were the exact appointment/payroll dates and substantive hours for the Richardson and Forshaw electorate-officer roles?
Was work for Euthanasia No!, the Australian Republican Movement and Aticus paid employment, contracting or governance, and how did the 1995–1997 roles overlap?
What is the verified corporate name and registration history for Aticus/Atticus Pty Ltd, and did the directorship involve substantive full-time work?
What were the exact SDA appointment/cessation dates, hours and leave, including any overlap with the 2003 state election campaign?
Was there paid employment or campaigning between resignation from the NSW Legislative Council on 24 June 2004 and federal election on 9 October 2004?
